<div class="card-body">
'''Jeroen Webb''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ジェローン・ウェッブ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に２を加える。反乱軍のリーダーとともに戦闘する場合、相手の戦闘運命数の合計から１を引く。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Jeroen-Webb-PSA-86099777.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ラルティア人。ラルティアが征服された後、同星の地下組織に潜伏し、スパイとして暗躍していた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Jeroen Webb.

'''Card text:'''
Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. When in battle with a Rebel leader, subtract 1 from the opponent's total battle destiny.

'''Lore:'''
A Ralltiirian. After Ralltiir was conquered, he hid in that planet's underground organization and secretly worked as a spy.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text adds 2 to 宇宙船 power, matching original printed “starship” rather than errata “anything”.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Jeroen Webb]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
